senses.gloss: ch. same, to groan, rumble (of the underground thunder at earthquakes).
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 59a:4">Ber. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ גוהא</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="C01074"><he>גְּנָא</he></cite>, Ms. O. <cite ref="C01096"><he>גְּנַהּ</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="C00322"><he>גּוּהָא</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: same, esp. to utter disconnected sounds (staccato), opp. to יליל to utter a trembling plaintive sound (tremolo).
